service.name: scenario-to-android
service.description: Turn any Vrooli scenario into a distributable Android application with evidence-backed validation on emulators and physical devices.

android-sdk.purpose: Governed Android SDK, platform-tools, emulator, system images, and AVD lifecycle for mobile validation.

device-control.purpose: Every device verb — install, launch, input, permission control, screenshot, screen recording — under a held lease. This ramp implements no device driving of its own.
device-control.degraded_behavior: Journey cells report unavailable naming device-control as the missing capability. The ramp never falls back to driving adb directly, because that would bypass leases and audit.

vrooli-bridge.purpose: Device and node reach plane: fleet registry, per-node scopes, allowlisted dispatch, and durable runs for remote Android targets.
vrooli-bridge.degraded_behavior: Remote targets report unavailable carrying the reach reason and are never silently omitted from inventory. The local emulator target remains usable.

deployment-manager.purpose: Consumes this ramp's reference-only common.v1.TargetVerdict and owns the cross-ramp release gate.
deployment-manager.degraded_behavior: The local gate still computes and evidence is retained; verdict emission retries. Evidence is never discarded because the consumer is down.

browser-automation-studio.purpose: Executes a scenario's own named web-content flows against the generated app's WebView, so an author writes a flow once and it replays on Android unchanged.
browser-automation-studio.degraded_behavior: Web-content chapters report unavailable; native shell chapters still execute and the run reports partial honestly rather than passing.

backdrop-studio.purpose: Provides the typed backdrop composition contract used by the Android journey adapter for scenario-owned web-content flows.
backdrop-studio.degraded_behavior: Journey web-content chapters report unavailable with the missing backdrop capability; the ramp never silently replaces the typed client.

secrets-manager.purpose: Holds the upload signing key by reference so no key material exists in this repository, in a generated project, or in evidence.
secrets-manager.degraded_behavior: Builds requiring a signed artifact report unavailable naming the signing rung. The ramp never generates an ad-hoc local key as a fallback.

hello-mobile.purpose: Conformance fixture. The ramp must be provable end to end without depending on any product scenario's correctness.
hello-mobile.degraded_behavior: The ramp's own conformance proof cannot run. Product scenario deliveries are unaffected.

scenario-to-desktop.purpose: Compile-time shared target-verdict domain contract used by the release matrix; the Android ramp does not call the desktop scenario at runtime.
scenario-to-desktop.degraded_behavior: The local release matrix cannot compile until the shared desktop-domain package is available; no desktop process is required at runtime.

descriptors.label: Android upload keystore
descriptors.description: Base64 PKCS12 upload keystore held by the credential authority; resolved only in memory during signing.

descriptors.label: Android upload keystore password
descriptors.description: Upload keystore password held by the credential authority.

descriptors.label: Android upload key alias
descriptors.description: Alias of the upload key inside the credential-authority-held keystore.
